title: Velvety Winey Egyptian Beurre-Noisette Skillet
description: A rich and indulgent Egyptian-inspired dish featuring a velvety beurre-noisette sauce, served in a cast-iron skillet.
instructions: Heat the cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes total.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the butter to the skillet and cook until it turns golden brown and has a nutty aroma.
Add the garlic and ginger to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the wine and cook until reduced by half, about 2 minutes.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a simmer.
Return the chicken to the skillet and simmer until cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the ferment-jang and cook for 1 minute, until well combined.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the chicken and sauce in the cast-iron skillet, garnished with fresh parsley.
Let the dish rest for 5 minutes before serving.
